# interval before

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:intervalBefore`](gmeow-intervalBefore.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/intervalBefore>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/temporal`](../../slices/temporal.md)

Allen BEFORE: this interval ends strictly before the related interval begins. Transitive. Inverse of [`gmeow:intervalAfter`](gmeow-intervalAfter.md). (= [time:intervalBefore](http://www.w3.org/2006/time#intervalBefore))
